rfi.title: Supplier Due-Diligence Enquiry — [Product]
rfi.intro: We are conducting pre-qualification checks ahead of a prospective purchase. Please reply in writing on company letterhead.

clauses.text: Confirm the full legal name, commercial registration (CR) number, address of the registered office, and legal form of the contracting entity, and attach a scan of the CR certificate.
Identify the exact entity that will issue the commercial invoice and the bill of lading as shipper, and state its relationship to the contracting entity.

If payment is to be made to an entity other than the contracting party, provide a signed payment instruction on company letterhead, a bank confirmation letter from the receiving bank, and a declaration of the relationship between the two entities.
Identify the production site(s) (plant name, city, country) from which the goods will originate, and attach the industrial licence covering those products.
State the annual and monthly nameplate capacity for the offered grade at the producing site, and the volume earmarked for this enquiry with indicative loading windows.
Provide the TDS for the grade offered, including all specified limits and test methods.
Provide a batch-level COA for a recent production batch of the same grade, on the producer's letterhead, showing test methods and results.
Provide the current SDS (revision number and date) issued by the producer named on the COA.
Confirm packaging and transport mode and, for bulk, the nominated load port and vessel/space arrangements.
Provide copies of valid management-system certificates with certificate numbers, issuing bodies and validity dates.
Provide two recent bills of lading (redacted) for the same product to confirm actual export performance and shipper identity.
Confirm whether any sanctions, export restrictions or force majeure currently affect your ability to perform, and describe any such measure with dates.
Provide an ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declaration and a group structure chart from the contracting entity to its ultimate parent.
Confirm the offer's validity period, delivery terms, governing law and dispute-resolution venue to be used in the contract.
